summary: Hamilton is an offline Android health dashboard that records metrics without an internet connection. It runs as a native mobile app and offers an API/SDK/webhook for programmatic access. The tool is suited for users who need local health tracking on Android devices, especially when connectivity is unavailable. While it provides extensive on‑page documentation and a changelog, it offers little differentiation from established apps like Samsung Health and Google Fit and lacks performance benchmarks.
